meta.source: Bradford White; Rheem/Ruud official age lookup; U.S. CPSC recall notices (2002, 2008, 2018); Energy Trust of Oregon decoder; InspectApedia and Building Intelligence Center for older styles; Whirlpool licensed site and warranty; American Water Heaters support pages; Navien warranty and lifespan pages; FastWaterHeater (third party, older Navien tags)
meta.notes: Per-brand page inputs: the example serial preset in each brand page's decoder, the hand-check cases (serial, the date a source gives, and that source), and the worked examples. The serials marked 'test serial' are made-up serials in the brand's real format (only the date characters matter); recall serials are real ranges from CPSC notices. Rheem/Ruud lookup answers were recorded on 2026-11-13. npm run build:data decodes every case with formulas.js and the brand pages print the results.
